about.en: LIQD is the ecosystem token of LiquidLabs, which builds DeFi infrastructure for HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain: LiquidCore, an oracle-validated AMM; LiquidSwap, a DEX aggregator routing across more than twenty venues; and LiquidLaunch, a permissionless token launchpad whose launches graduate into LiquidCore liquidity. LiquidLabs says LIQD is required to provide liquidity to public LiquidCore pools.
